title: Reject Invalid Month End Dates
teaser: Calendar parsing must not normalize an impossible June date into July.
full_text: Feed dates beyond June 30 2035 into the canonical parser and verify it returns an explicit validation failure instead of overflow normalization.

title: Fail Closed When UT1 Is Unavailable
teaser: Astronomy output must not invent missing Earth orientation data.
full_text: Run a fixture without a usable UT1 offset and verify the calculation layer surfaces missing provenance as an error.

title: Normalize House Cusp Ordering
teaser: Zodiac wraparound must not scramble the twelve house boundaries.
full_text: Use a cusp fixture that crosses zero degrees and verify all twelve cusps remain ordered and unique.

title: Carry Unknown Birth Time Through the Chart
teaser: Time-sensitive results must not appear certain when birth time is missing.
full_text: Generate a chart for an unknown-time profile and verify affected fields use the contracted uncertainty state.

title: Reject Unexpected Files Inside Backups
teaser: Restore packages must contain only manifest-declared content.
full_text: Add an extra file not listed in the backup manifest and verify integrity checks reject the package.

title: Check Free Disk Space Before Restore
teaser: Low storage must not leave a partial transaction behind.
full_text: Provide storage below the required temporary-space threshold and verify restore stops before mutation begins.

title: Recalculate PDF Page Numbers After Section Filtering
teaser: Hidden sections must not leave gaps in pagination.
full_text: Generate a report with selected sections disabled and verify footer page numbers match the actual rendered page count.

title: Resolve Localized Feature Names from Stable IDs
teaser: Changing language must never change entitlement identity.
full_text: Resolve the same feature ID in Turkish and English and verify access decisions remain locale independent.

title: Bound Rewarded Ad Retry Loops
teaser: Repeated load failures must not trap the user in an endless spinner.
full_text: Simulate consecutive rewarded-load failures and verify backoff plus a recoverable user state appears.

title: Guard PRO Routes Reached by Deep Link
teaser: Direct navigation must not bypass paid access rules.
full_text: Open a PRO deep link while in Free state and verify routing passes through the entitlement guard and safe paywall flow.

title: Keep Biometric Cancellation Locked
teaser: Cancelling authentication must never be interpreted as success.
full_text: Cancel the biometric prompt and verify the protected profile remains inaccessible.

title: Align Semantics Labels with Visible Actions
teaser: Assistive technology should hear the same meaning the screen shows.
full_text: Compare visible titles and semantics labels on primary action cards and verify their meanings match.

title: Prevent Layout Breakage at Two Hundred Percent Text Scale
teaser: Large text must not hide critical actions.
full_text: Render core forms at 200 percent text scale and verify no essential button clips or overflows horizontally.

title: Persist Stable Location IDs from Search
teaser: Displayed city names are not reliable database keys.
full_text: Choose between two same-name city fixtures and verify persistence stores the unique location ID rather than display text.

title: Canonicalize Timezone Aliases
teaser: Legacy zone aliases should not change results across builds.
full_text: Normalize supported timezone aliases to canonical IANA zones and compare their resolved offsets.

title: Verify Ephemeris Checksums at Startup
teaser: Corrupted astronomy data must never be consumed silently.
full_text: Change one byte in an ephemeris fixture and verify the provider reports a checksum failure before calculations run.

title: Keep Aspect Grid Symmetric While Treating the Diagonal Separately
teaser: Mirrored matrix cells must not disagree.
full_text: Compare upper and lower aspect-grid triangles for one chart and verify self-cells follow the dedicated diagonal policy.

title: Centralize Master Number Reduction Rules
teaser: Handling of 11 22 and 33 must not vary by screen.
full_text: Calculate identical inputs through multiple numerology entry points and verify master-number policy produces the same core values.

title: Compute the BaZi Hour Pillar After Timezone Resolution
teaser: Local birth time must not be treated as raw UTC.
full_text: Use a birth fixture near a timezone boundary and verify the hour pillar is derived from canonical local civil time.

title: Block Builds with Unproven Tarot Assets
teaser: Unlicensed or untracked artwork must not enter release packages.
full_text: Add a tarot asset fixture without provenance metadata and verify asset-manifest validation fails the build.

title: Support the First Launch Offline
teaser: Network absence must not disable features backed entirely by bundled data.
full_text: Start a clean install in airplane mode and verify supported local routes remain usable.

title: Make Database Migrations Idempotent
teaser: Re-running an upgrade must not duplicate or mutate valid data.
full_text: Trigger the same schema migration path twice and verify row counts plus stable IDs remain unchanged.

title: Roll Search Cache Back with Failed Transactions
teaser: A rollback must not leave newly indexed records visible.
full_text: Inject an error before commit and verify both table state and search-cache snapshot return to the prior version.

title: Allowlist Consultation Export Fields
teaser: New model properties must not leak into exports automatically.
full_text: Use a fixture containing an extra domain field and verify export writes only columns explicitly approved by policy.

title: Exercise PDF Font Fallback with Turkish Glyphs
teaser: Unicode text must not render as missing-glyph boxes.
full_text: Generate a report containing Turkish-specific letters and verify embedded font coverage includes every required glyph.

title: Neutralize Spreadsheet Formula Injection
teaser: User text must not execute when CSV is opened in a spreadsheet.
full_text: Export values beginning with equals plus minus and at-sign characters and verify the configured safe escaping policy.

title: Stay Quiet After Notification Permission Is Denied
teaser: A rejected permission must not cause repeated prompts on every resume.
full_text: Deny notification access and verify later app-resume events do not force another prompt.

title: Refresh Entitlements After Resume
teaser: Long background periods must not leave stale access decisions.
full_text: Background the app with PRO access then change expiry and verify resume recomputes the entitlement state.

title: Scan June Against Historical Exact Duplicates
teaser: Fresh editorial copy must not repeat earlier locale content verbatim.
full_text: Compare June fields against all prior shards within each locale and reject the batch on any exact collision.

title: Close June Coverage from Main
teaser: Local draft files are not reviewed coverage.
full_text: Reload both June shards from main verify thirty canonical dates per locale and record July 1 2035 as the next exact start.
